name: GWAP MASTER
hard_rules: External technology informs GWAP; it does not control GWAP.
Current GWAP repo/deployed reality outranks upstream default-stack recommendations.
No mainnet deployment, authority change, custody activation, or automated mainnet spending without explicit approval.
Protocol activation claims require target-environment evidence.
IDL/interface verification does not replace binary provenance verification.
Digital assets must be justified by user outcome before selecting an NFT/token primitive.
